{{Quote|You will form up near the warriors in crimson, your rally masters. Look for them and listen to them. They'll teach you our ways - and keep you alive when we get to Alderaan!|The Rally Master speaking to a crowd of new recruits on [[Jebble]]|<ref name="Vector2">[[Knights of the Old Republic 26|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 26]]</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Rally Master]]''' was a member of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="Vector2" />

On the planet [[Jebble]], when the [[Drovian]] Mandalorian recruit, [[Wargo]], attempted to assault the con-artist [[Marn Hierogryph]], the Rally Master smashed him in the face with the butt of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] in an attempt to keep order among the unruly hordes of new recruits. The Rally Master later gave a speech to the assembled recruits that they would be attacking [[Alderaan]].<ref name="Vector2" /> However, the planned attack on Alderaan never came to pass, as the dark influence of the [[Muur Talisman]] transmitted the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] to many Mandalorians on Jebble, turning them into rampaging [[rakghoul]] beasts. Upon being bitten by a [[Mando-Rak]] during the [[disaster on Jebble]], the Rally Master urged for it to be killed, only to instead be shot by Wargo immediately afterwards.<ref name="Vector3" />
